verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents several public APIs: the Pipelines API and Track API for data in, and the App API for broadcasts, transactional messages and data fetching. It also provides a Postman collection, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.customer.io/openapi.json. Agent-oriented access is documented too, through a CLI giving AI agents and scripts full workspace access and an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API in practice, and explicit documentation that the REST API itself (not just the CLI or MCP) covers managing automations and segments.
